newsitem.title: JAPAN: Henderson Land seen listing shares on TSE--paper.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land seen listing shares on TSE--paper.

text.p: Hong Kong property developer Henderson Land Development Co Ltd is expected to list its shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) as early as February, a Japanese business daily said on Monday.

Henderson Land would be the first Hong Kong firm and only the second non-Japanese firm in Asia to list shares on the TSE, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said. It said the company aims to diversify its sources of fund-raising.
The TSE declined to comment on the report. No comment from Henderson Land was immediately available in Tokyo.
Malaysian infrastructure developer YTL Corp became the first non-Japanese company in Asia to list its shares on the TSE in February this year.
